brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted a raid and search campaign in Dura, a town in the West Bank, detaining a number of residents, the Ma'an news agency reported. The operation involved systematic searches of homes and arrest procedures targeting the civilian population.

Details of the specific number of detainees and the stated reason for the military action were not immediately clear. Such raids remain a frequent occurrence across Palestinian towns and villages in the occupied West Bank.
title: Israeli forces raid Dura, detain residents in sweep operation
